name: Alessandro Ricci
title: Junior NLP Engineer
summary: Junior NLP Engineer with hands-on experience building text classification, information extraction, and retrieval solutions using Python and modern NLP frameworks. Comfortable working across data preparation, model evaluation, and API integration, with a strong focus on reproducible experiments and measurable improvements.

bullets: Built Python-based text classification pipelines for customer support tickets, improving routing accuracy by 18% on a held-out validation set.
Fine-tuned transformer models with Hugging Face and PyTorch for intent detection and entity extraction across 6 Italian-language domains.
Developed FastAPI endpoints to serve inference results, reducing average response time from 1.8s to 620ms.
Automated experiment tracking and dataset versioning, cutting manual QA effort by 30%.
Preprocessed and labeled 25k+ documents for topic classification and named entity recognition using Python and spaCy.
Evaluated multiple baseline models in scikit-learn, increasing F1 score from 0.71 to 0.83 for the final prototype.
Created reusable scripts for tokenization, cleaning, and train/validation splits, reducing preprocessing time by 40%.
Supported weekly model reviews by preparing clear performance reports and error analyses.
Assisted with feature engineering and text normalization for a multilingual sentiment analysis proof of concept.
Worked with SQL to extract and join 100k+ rows of annotated feedback data from internal databases.
Documented model assumptions and evaluation results, enabling faster handoff to the engineering team.
Contributed Python notebooks that standardized dataset inspection and baseline benchmarking.
Supported an academic project on Italian text mining, cleaning and structuring corpora with Python scripts.
Compared classical NLP approaches and transformer baselines for document categorization, identifying a 12% lift in macro-F1.
Prepared datasets and reproducible notebooks used in internal presentations and student workshops.
Collaborated with supervisors to publish technical notes on error patterns and annotation consistency.

education.degree: MSc in Computer Science, Data Science track
